subject: Post-signature cutover & onboarding roadmap — proposed MAP with canary phases (Horizon Health)
messages:
From: Emily Stone <emily.stone@horizonhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: onboard@horizonhealth.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: post-signature rollout map and training cadence

Karthik —

Thanks again for the quick signature last week. We're lining up resources on our side and want to lock the mutual action plan (MAP) so we can hit the October launch window. A few priorities from Horizon:

- Minimal customer impact during migration (must maintain 99.5% availability for auth flows)
- Internal training for support and SRE teams (2x 90-minute sessions + sandboxes)
- A canary cadence that lets us validate traffic shaping on a 2% slice before full cutover

Can you share a MAP that embeds the rollout, canary, migration and training steps? Ideally a week-by-week view for the next 12 weeks and an owner for each milestone. Also please include any prework we should complete (IP allowlist, SSO test accounts, test data scrub).

Emily
Emily Stone
Director, Product Ops — Horizon Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: post-signature rollout map and training cadence

Emily —

Appreciate the summary. Draft MAP attached (redwood_mpa_draft_horizon_v1.xlsx) and a short canary runbook (canary-runbook-v1.md). High-level plan below; attachments have the week-by-week checklist with owners and acceptance criteria.

Summary (12-week cadence):
1) Weeks 1–2: Prework & environment prep
   - IP allowlist + VPC peering validation (Jonas)
   - Provide SSO test accounts & S3 test bucket (Horizon)
   - Provision dedicated dev/test nodes in our Dedicated pool
2) Weeks 3–5: Integration & training sprint
   - Integration smoke tests (feature parity, latency targets)
   - Two live training sessions: Support + SRE (Maya leads)
   - Hands-on sandboxes for Horizon engineers
3) Weeks 6–8: Canary & staged migration
   - Canary phase A (2% traffic, 72h soak, automated regression checks)
   - Canary phase B (10% traffic, 48h soak, acceptance gating)
   - Rollback procedures and fallback route configured
4) Weeks 9–11: Full cutover & monitoring ramp
   - Gradual ramp to 100% over 48–72h
   - Enhanced monitoring and burn-in metrics (token latency, error rate, cost delta)
5) Week 12: Hypercare & lessons learned
   - Daily syncs drop to weekly; capture runbook updates and training handoff

Canary specifics (excerpt):
- Initial canary run: 2% of sessions, synthetic and real traffic mix, 72h soak.
- Success criteria: latency P95 within 1.2x baseline; error rate <0.2%; no QA regressions on core prompt set.
- If failure: immediate re-route to blue variant, initiate postmortem, invoke rollback checklist in canary-runbook-v1.md.

Open asks for Horizon:
- Confirm preferred training dates (we have tentative slots 7/28 & 7/30)
- Confirm list of SSO test accounts and IP ranges to allowlist
- Identify primary SRE contact for fast escalation

We'll iterate the MAP based on your feedback and convert into the HubSpot mutual action milestone tracker.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Engineering — Redwood Inference
(Attachment: redwood_mpa_draft_horizon_v1.xlsx; canary-runbook-v1.md)

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@horizonhealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: post-signature rollout map and training cadence

Hi Emily / team —

I've reviewed the MAP and the canary runbook. A couple of practical notes from Onboarding:

- Training: we'll run two 90-minute instructor-led sessions (Support & SRE) plus a self-paced lab. We recommend 6–8 attendees per live session to keep Q&A manageable. Please confirm headcount and preferred timezone.
- Sandboxes: we'll seed a mirror dataset (anonymized) for Horizon's developers. Please provide a data share checklist and confirmation that the sample size is acceptable.
- Cutover blackout windows: are there any dates in September/October where Horizon cannot risk even a 2% canary? If so we need to adjust the canary schedule.

Operational owners on our side: Jonas will own the networking/prep gating; I'll own training and acceptance exercises; Karthik will coordinate milestone approvals.

I'll update the spreadsheet with training slots and a preliminary runbook for the sandboxes by EOD.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Onboarding Manager — Redwood Inference
(Attachment: onboarding-schedule-proposal.xlsx)

From: Emily Stone <emily.stone@horizonhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
Cc: onboard@horizonhealth.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: post-signature rollout map and training cadence

Thanks — this looks good and very actionable. Quick answers:

- Training headcount: Support 6, SRE 5. Prefers eastern time afternoon slots. 7/28 & 7/30 both work.
- Sandboxes: we'll sign the data share checklist; we'll provide a 10k-row anonymized dataset by 7/23.
- Blackout windows: none planned for Sept/Oct at this time.

Please go ahead and lock the MAP into HubSpot and send calendar invites for the training sessions. We'll confirm SSO test accounts (I'll email the list tomorrow).

Emily
Emily Stone
Director, Product Ops — Horizon Health
